mostWorthwhile.text: Ren checking the complete system and watching pressure and flow before releasing the pump made the restoration feel tangible and responsible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The succession of single-option fittings felt somewhat mechanical, even though their purposes were clear.

surprise.text: The stop was tested with the network lead absent, making its independence concrete rather than just a claim.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the local reporting address initially seemed less essential than the stop, but its limited role was explained.

continue.text: Yes. The working water service was a satisfying payoff, and the local network suggests more practical problems worth exploring, although the linear fittings were less engaging.
